acceptable_variants: Open-Meteo selected and ERA5 aggregate rejected
direct time-series source arbitration with numeric impact
judge_anchors.canonical_stance: Use the locked event window and Open-Meteo direct daily/hourly series; reject ERA5 aggregate stats as non-reproducible for the 3-day and hot-hour RH calculations.
do_not_infer: daily sequences or hot-hour RH from aggregate-only products
values from web sources or hidden answer files
required_elements: Use the locked event anchor for the inclusive 2021-06-25 to 2021-07-01 event window.
Select Open-Meteo because it has daily Tmax/Tmin and hourly temperature/RH arrays.
Reject ERA5-Land aggregate stats because it lacks the daily sequence and hourly RH rows.
Quantify the rejected aggregate max as 31.3 C and the peak understatement as 4.2 C.
Return compact source-arbitration JSON rather than a threshold ledger or broad disaster explanation.

key_values.arbitration_basis: direct time-series evidence outranks aggregate-only stats for reconstructing a windowed sequence calculation

criteria.description: Returns only the requested JSON with answer_type = expert_source_arbitration.
criteria.name: JSON schema and answer type
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for mostly valid JSON with minor schema omissions.

criteria.description: Selects the Open-Meteo archive, rejects the ERA5-Land aggregate stats file, and cites the locked event anchor, all with package-relative paths.
criteria.name: Source arbitration
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-3 points for identifying some but not all roles correctly.

criteria.description: Uses the inclusive 2021-06-25 to 2021-07-01 window and reports 7 daily rows plus 168 hourly rows.
criteria.name: Event-window filtering
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for correct dates with incomplete row accounting.

criteria.description: Reports peak Tmax 35.5 C on 2021-06-29, hottest 3-day mean 33.9 C for 2021-06-27/2021-06-29, 29 hot hours, and hot-hour mean RH 24.0 percent.
criteria.name: Selected-source calculations
criteria.partial_credit: Award up to 4 points for correct formulas with one missing or slightly misrounded value.

criteria.description: Reads stats.temperature_2m_max_c_max as 31.3 C and computes the 4.2 C peak understatement if it is wrongly substituted.
criteria.name: Invalid alternative and numeric impact
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for the right rejected field or the right consequence but not both.

criteria.description: Explains that the selected source is direct daily/hourly series evidence and the rejected file is aggregate-only evidence that cannot reproduce the 3-day or hot-hour RH calculations.
criteria.name: Source-path reasoning
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for a weaker but still package-grounded reason.

criteria.description: Does not use web evidence, hidden answers, broad disaster explanation, response advice, or non-package values.
criteria.name: Evidence boundary discipline
